observations: body L1: the dot of the second i of «definitio» is printed as a short slanting stroke.
body L3: «٥٢{4}» has a 2 with one crest (3.0 points) after the 5.
body L7: «٣١–٣٣» has 3s with two crests (4.6-4.8 points); the dash between them is an en dash (5.2 points).
body L9, L12, L17: «٢٦٦» has a 2 joined to a 6 (5.8 points) and a 6 apart; «١٨٦» ends in a 6; «٩٦» has a 9 and a 6.
body L10: «٢٤٧» has a 2 joined to a 4 (6.6 points) and a 7.
body L9: «τὸ» has the grave accent; the article ὁ of L10 and L11 is the δ-shaped sort with the head turned to the right (the rough breathing).
body L11: «الكَأسُ» has the hamza over the alif, without a sukun.
body L13, L14: «الجَبَّار» (L13) has no vowel sign on its final rāʾ; the damma under it belongs to «ذَاتُ» of L14.
body L15: «ϑρόνου» and «καϑεζομένη» are printed with the theta ϑ.
body L17: «كُرِيٌّ» has the shadda and the dammatan on the yāʾ and a kasra under the rāʾ; the rāʾ has no shadda.
body L20: «ستّين» has the shadda alone; «جُزْءًا» has the hamza with the fatḥatān cast as one sort.
body L21: «تكسِر» is printed without a yāʾ, with a kasra under the sīn. «ساعة» is printed with a kashīda, not transcribed.
body L24: «p 31» is printed without a point after the p.
body L36: the Hebrew «שִׁבּוּר» has the shin dot, a ḥiriq under the shin, a dagesh in the bet and the shuruq.

notes_left L2: «قِيسَ» has a kasra under the qāf and a fatḥa on the sīn; «قُيِسَ» a damma on the qāf, a kasra under the yāʾ and a fatḥa on the sīn. Both are printed with elongated joins (kashīda), not transcribed.
